Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent true
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId and absent set to true
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given employeeId exists
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId and absent true
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance record with absent true
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance record showing absent true

Title: Mark attendance with valid employeeId and absent false
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId and absent set to false
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given employeeId exists
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId and absent false
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance record with absent false
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance record showing absent false

Title: Mark attendance with null request body
Description: Verify response when request body is null
Pre-Conditions: None
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with null body
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeI and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeI and absent required'

Title: Mark attendance with missing employeeId
Description: Verify response when employeeId is missing in request body
Pre-Conditions: None
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body missing employeeId
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeI and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeI and absent required'

Title: Mark attendance with missing absent field
Description: Verify response when absent field is missing in request body
Pre-Conditions: None
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body missing absent field
Verify response status is 400
Verify response body contains message 'employeeI and absent required'
Expected Result: Response status 400 with message 'employeeI and absent required'

Title: Mark attendance with date provided
Description: Verify marking attendance with valid employeeId, absent and date provided
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given employeeId exists
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/attendance/mark with body containing employeeId, absent and date
Verify response status is 200
Verify response body contains attendance record with given date
Expected Result: Response status 200 with attendance record showing date 2024-06-01

Title: Mark batch attendance with valid payload
Description: Send a POST request to /mark-batch with a valid list of attendance DTOs
Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects with valid employeeId and absent values
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries
Verify response contains presentCount and absentCount matching input data
Verify response contains invalidEntries as empty list
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount 2, presentCount 1, absentCount 1, invalidEntries []

Title: Mark batch attendance with empty payload
Description: Send a POST request to /mark-batch with an empty list
Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Prepare an empty list
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with empty list as body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with null payload
Description: Send a POST request to /mark-batch with null body
Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with null body
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify response body contains message 'payload is empty'
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'payload is empty'

Title: Mark batch attendance with some invalid entries
Description: Send a POST request to /mark-batch with some DTOs missing employeeId or absent
Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects where some have null employeeId or absent
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response contains savedCount equal to number of valid entries
Verify response contains invalidEntries list with employeeIds of invalid entries that have employeeId
Verify response contains presentCount and absentCount matching valid entries
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount 2, presentCount 1, absentCount 1, invalidEntries [3]

Title: Mark batch attendance with all invalid entries
Description: Send a POST request to /mark-batch with all DTOs missing employeeId or absent
Pre-Conditions: Attendance service and repository are available
Test Steps: Prepare a list of AttendanceDTO objects all missing employeeId or absent
Send POST request to /api/attendance/mark-batch with the list as body
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response contains savedCount 0
Verify response contains invalidEntries list with employeeIds of invalid entries that have employeeId
Verify presentCount and absentCount are 0
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with savedCount 0, presentCount 0, absentCount 0, invalidEntries [5]

Title: Get all employees successfully
Description: Verify that GET /api/employe returns list of all employees
Pre-Conditions: At least one employee exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe
Receive response
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains list of employees

Title: Get employee by valid id
Description: Verify that the API returns employee details when a valid id is provided
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with valid employee id
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with employee details in response body

Title: Get employee by non-existing id
Description: Verify that the API returns 404 status when employee id does not exist
Pre-Conditions: No employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with non-existing employee id
Expected Result: Response status 404 Not Found with message 'employee not found in db'

Title: Get employee with null id
Description: Verify that the API returns 400 status when id is null
Pre-Conditions: None
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/employe/{id} with null id
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with message 'id is required'

Title: Update employee with valid id and valid body
Description: Verify updating an existing employee with valid id and valid request body updates the employee and returns 200
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in database
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Include valid employee data in request body with fields to update
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with updated employee data in response body

Title: Update employee with null id
Description: Verify updating employee with null id returns 400 with error message
Pre-Conditions: None
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with body {"message":"id is required"}

Title: Update employee with null request body
Description: Verify updating employee with null request body returns 400 with error message
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in database
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Send null or empty request body
Expected Result: Response status 400 Bad Request with body {"message":"request body is required"}

Title: Update employee with non-existing id
Description: Verify updating employee with id not present in database returns 404 with error message
Pre-Conditions: No employee with given id exists in database
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
Send valid request body
Expected Result: Response status 404 Not Found with body {"message":"employee not found"}

Title: Update employee with partial fields in request body
Description: Verify updating employee with partial fields updates only those fields and returns 200
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in database
Test Steps: Send PUT request to /api/employee/{id} with valid id
Send request body with only some fields (e.g. only name)
Expected Result: Response status 200 OK with employee updated only for provided fields

Title: Delete employee with valid id
Description: Verify deleting an existing employee by valid id returns 204 No Content
Pre-Conditions: Employee with given id exists in the database
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with valid existing id
Expected Result: Response status is 204 No Content and employee is deleted from database

Title: Delete employee with non-existing id
Description: Verify deleting an employee with non-existing id returns 404 with message
Pre-Conditions: No employee exists with the given id
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with non-existing id
Expected Result: Response status is 404 Not Found with body {"message":"employee not found"}

Title: Delete employee with null id
Description: Verify deleting an employee with null id returns 400 with message
Pre-Conditions: None
Test Steps: Send DELETE request to /api/employee/{id} with id as null or missing
Expected Result: Response status is 400 Bad Request with body {"message":"id is required"}

Title: Get test cases when final-testcases.json exists
Description: Verify GET /api/testcases returns 200 and JSON content when final-testcases.json file exists
Pre-Conditions: final-testcases.json file exists in test-cases folder
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/testcases
Verify response status code is 200
Verify response body is valid JSON
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains JSON array or object from final-testcases.json

Title: Get test cases when final-testcases.json does not exist but all-tests.json exists
Description: Verify GET /api/testcases returns 200 and JSON content when final-testcases.json is missing but all-tests.json file exists
Pre-Conditions: final-testcases.json file does not exist and all-tests.json file exists in test-cases folder
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/testcases
Verify response status code is 200
Verify response body is valid JSON
Expected Result: Response status is 200 OK and response body contains JSON array or object from all-tests.json

Title: Get test cases when no test case JSON files exist
Description: Verify GET /api/testcases returns 404 with error message when neither final-testcases.json nor all-tests.json exist
Pre-Conditions: Neither final-testcases.json nor all-tests.json file exists in test-cases folder
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/testcases
Verify response status code is 404
Verify response body contains error message
Expected Result: Response status is 404 Not Found and response body is 'Test cases JSON not found. Run mvn -q -DskipTests exec:java first.'

Title: Get test cases when file reading throws exception
Description: Verify GET /api/testcases returns 500 with error message when an exception occurs during file reading
Pre-Conditions: Simulate exception during reading of test case JSON files
Test Steps: Send GET request to /api/testcases
Verify response status code is 500
Verify response body contains error message starting with 'Error reading test cases:'
Expected Result: Response status is 500 Internal Server Error and response body contains 'Error reading test cases:' followed by exception message
